resources.string: Maintains an overlay view for screen dimming and blue light filtering to reduce eye strain during night use.
The filter is off, but the accessibility service is still running in the background.

Nyx requires Accessibility permissions to apply the screen filter over the entire system, including the navigation bar and lock screen.\n\nSwipe the \"Filter is OFF\" switch to the right to open System Settings, then find \'Nyx\' in the list and turn the service on.
Warms the screen with the system\'s Night Light instead of an overlay, so black pixels stay truly black. Needs a one-time setup.
Blue Light Filter and Color Temperature are applied by Night Light (limited to your device\'s range). Dimming stays a black overlay, so blacks stay black. Black Level is not used.

True black mode needs a permission that Android only lets you grant from a computer. Connect your phone with USB debugging turned on and run:

%1$s

Then come back to Nyx and turn this switch on.
Couldn\'t change the system color filter. Switched back to overlay mode.
